v1_human_g2_ac.ac_1: given the user provides no existing events when meeting duration is 30 minutes on a Monday then at least 1 slot is suggested
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_2: given the user provides a day either today today when meeting duration is valid then at least 1 slot is suggested
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_3: given user provides an invalid day then the day is marked as invalid
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_4: given meeting duration is invalid then an empty list is given
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_5: given user provided a full event schedule when meeting duration is any thing then empty list is returned
v1_human_g2_ac.ac_6: given user provides an event schedule with at least 1 minute unscheduled when meeting duration is 1 then at least 1 slot is returned

v1_human_g2_constraints.c_2: No date/invalid date defaults to today
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_3: meeting duration is an int be below 24x60
v1_human_g2_constraints.c_4: day is a 3 letter day abbreviation of a "YYYY-MM-DD" date

v1_human_g2_goal: Suggest valid start times for a meeting that respect typical work times and does not conflict with existing events
v1_human_g2_input: Events: a list of dictionaries containing the current day's existing events with keys ("start", "HH:MM", "end", "HH:MM"). Meeting_duration: an int when represents the desired meeting length in minutes. day: 3 letter string representing day of the week, 5) list 3 letters at start day of the week
v1_human_g2_output: a list of valid start times (within typical work hours, non conflicted with existing events) at least meeting duration length for a meeting, the list is in format "HH:MM" sorted ascending
